description: Deterministically resolve a folder and request an async download for every CONVERTED video (POST /download-async/{externalId}). Without quality, each video is requested at the highest quality it has; with a quality, videos that don't have it are skipped with the reason. Results list each video's status and `url` when it is already ready (temporary signed link); poll the others with panda_check_download_status. dry_run=true (default) previews the requests.

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

language.description: Audio language: 'default' (original audio) or the code of a dubbed audio (e.g. 'en'). 'original' is read as 'default'.

quality.description: Quality: one of 240p, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 1440p, 2160p, original ('1080' is read as '1080p'). Default: the highest quality of each video.

name: panda_action_request_folder_downloads
title: Request Folder Downloads
